records.subject: Get your team moving with Wrenfield
records.body:
Hi Keiko,

A reminder that your Wrenfield workspace is ready whenever you are -- creating one real project is the easiest way to see what it's for.

Warmly,
Elena Kelly

records.subject: Welcome aboard, Granite Dynamics
records.body:
Hi Keiko,

Welcome! A lot of new teams ask us the same thing in the first few days: how do I get my team in here. Short answer -- a teammate can be invited from Account Settings -> Members at any time.

Reply any time.

Thanks,
Chidi Haddad

decisions.rationale: First project reached day 1 (2026-07-07) shows real intent, but no invites sent, zero tickets, and no reply to three Wrenfield emails (email:70fbebb1, email:da415c16, email:124cae4f) in 6 days suggests disengagement; 8 days left on Starter.

draft.subject: One next step in Wrenfield
draft.body:
Hi Keiko,

Following up on my note last week — you've already created a project, which is the main thing. Projects are the main organizing unit in Wrenfield, and tasks live inside them, so adding a few real tasks to that project is usually the fastest way to see whether it fits how Granite Dynamics works. When you're ready to bring others in, a teammate can be invited from Account Settings -> Members at any time.

Would a short call this week help? Happy to walk through your project with you and answer anything that's unclear.

Best,
Chidi
